name: Create docker-compose provider with compose overlay
description:
Create the generic docker-compose provider that accepts pre-authored compose files and layers tailscale on top via compose overlay. This is the mac-nix migration path.

**Artifacts:**
- [design](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/design.md)
- [spec](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/specs/docker-compose-base/spec.md)

**What to implement:**

1. Create `providers/docker-compose.nix`:
   - Import and use `lib/docker-compose.nix` shared functions
   - `up()` reads the consumer's docker-compose.yml from providerConfig.path
   - Generates a tailscale overlay at .saas-controller/compose/<serviceName>/tailscale-overlay.yml
   - The overlay adds the tailscale service (from mkTailscaleSidecar) and sets network_mode: service:tailscale on all app services
   - Generates serve-config.json from providerConfig.tailscale entries (list of { port, upstream })
   - Runs lifecycle via: docker compose -f <original> -f <overlay> up -d --build --wait
   - Uses mkComposeLifecycle for the up/down/logs/cleanup lifecycle

2. `providerConfig` schema for docker-compose provider:
   ```nix
   providerConfig = {
     path = "services/miniflux";        # directory with compose file
     composeFile = "docker-compose.yml"; # optional, defaults to docker-compose.yml
     tailscale = [                       # serve entries
       { port = 443; upstream = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"; }
     ];
   };
   ```

3. Register in devenv.nix builtinProviders

4. The overlay needs to discover service names from the original compose file to apply network_mode. Use yq or grep to list service names, or accept them as providerConfig.

**Files:**
- Create: `providers/docker-compose.nix`
- Modify: `devenv.nix` (register in builtinProviders)
- Modify: `providers/TEMPLATE.nix` (reference docker-compose as example)

**Verification:**
- A test service using docker-compose provider with a pre-authored compose file starts successfully with tailscale sidecar
- HTTPS URL is accessible on the tailnet
- sc up lifecycle (start, logs, cleanup) works correctly

name: Refactor hello-world and zuplo providers to use shared library
description:
Refactor both providers to delegate their compose lifecycle to `lib/docker-compose.nix`.

**Artifacts:**
- [design](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/design.md)
- [spec](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/specs/docker-compose-base/spec.md)

**What to implement:**

**hello-world.nix:**
- Import and call `mkTailscaleSidecar` for the sidecar YAML
- Call `mkServeConfig` with `[{ port = 443; upstream = "http://127.0.0.1:3000"; }]`
- Call `mkComposeLifecycle` for the up/down/logs/cleanup script
- The provider's `up()` should only define the app service and pass it to the library
- Verify generated compose stack is functionally identical to current output

**zuplo.nix:**
- Import and call `mkTailscaleSidecar` for the sidecar YAML
- Call `mkServeConfig` with the docs (port 443) and api (port 8443) entries
- Call `mkComposeLifecycle` for the lifecycle script
- Keep zuplo-specific logic: Dockerfile generation, npm workspace package.json copying, zuplo-api and zuplo-docs service definitions, VITE host allowlist, ZUDOKU_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL
- Compose the final docker-compose.yml from: sidecar (from library) + app services (zuplo-specific) + volumes

**Files:**
- Modify: `providers/hello-world.nix`
- Modify: `providers/zuplo.nix`
- Modify: `devenv.nix` (import lib/docker-compose.nix, pass to providers)

**Verification:**
- `sc up` produces functionally identical compose stacks
- Both providers build and run correctly

name: Add three-layer secret composition with extraSecrets and auto-include
description:
Add per-instance `secrets` option and auto-include provider profiles in TOML generation.

**Artifacts:**
- [design](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/design.md)
- [spec](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/specs/secret-composition/spec.md)

**What to implement:**

1. Add `secrets` option to the secretspec environment submodule (attrsOf with description/required/providers, same schema as secretProfiles entries)

2. Update `mkServiceSecretspecToml` to:
   - Accept the full service object (not just secretspecCfg)
   - Look up `providers.${service.provider}.secretProfiles` and prepend those profile names
   - Use `lib.unique` to deduplicate profile names
   - Append inline `secrets` from the environment config after profile secrets
   - Update all call sites (generateAllServiceSecretspecs, sc check-secrets)

3. Update test-gateway config:
   - Remove "zuplo" from serviceProfiles (now auto-included)
   - Optionally add example inline secrets for demonstration

**Files:**
- Modify: `devenv.nix` (option schema, mkServiceSecretspecToml, call sites, test-gateway config)

**Verification:**
- Generated secretspec.toml includes provider secrets without explicit listing
- Inline secrets appear in generated TOML
- `sc check-secrets` works with auto-included profiles
- Nix evaluates without errors

name: Extract shared compose lifecycle into lib/docker-compose.nix
description:
Extract the duplicated tailscale sidecar + compose lifecycle code from zuplo.nix and hello-world.nix into a shared library at `lib/docker-compose.nix`.

**Artifacts:**
- [proposal](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/proposal.md)
- [design](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/design.md)
- [spec](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/specs/docker-compose-base/spec.md)

**What to implement:**

Create `lib/docker-compose.nix` exporting three functions:

1. `mkTailscaleSidecar { hostname }` — Returns the YAML string for the tailscale sidecar service with TS_AUTHKEY, TS_EXTRA_ARGS=--advertise-tags=tag:sc-dev, TS_SERVE_CONFIG, healthcheck, NET_ADMIN, /dev/net/tun.

2. `mkServeConfig { entries }` — Takes a list of `{ port, upstream }` and generates the serve-config.json content using `${TS_CERT_DOMAIN}` placeholder. Remember Nix escaping: `''${TS_CERT_DOMAIN}`.

3. `mkComposeLifecycle { composeFile, serviceName }` — Returns the bash script for: docker compose up -d --build --wait, error log dump on failure, cleanup trap, HTTPS URL printing, docker compose logs -f.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/docker-compose.nix`

**Verification:**
- File evaluates without Nix errors
- Functions return expected string output (verify manually by inspecting)

name: docker-compose-provider
description:
OpenSpec change: Extract a generic docker-compose base provider, add three-layer secret composition with SA token swapping, and enable mac-nix migration.

**What Changes:**
- Extract `docker-compose` base provider owning tailscale sidecar + compose lifecycle
- Refactor zuplo/hello-world to delegate compose lifecycle to base
- Add `extraSecrets`, `saToken`, `saTokensDir` options for per-instance secret composition
- Auto-include provider secret profiles when service uses that provider
- Rewrite `sc up` to per-service secret injection with SA token swap

**Artifacts:**
- [proposal](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/proposal.md)
- [design](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/design.md)
- [specs](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/specs/)

To start implementation: /opsx:apply docker-compose-provider

name: Add SA token swap with per-service secret injection in sc up
description:
Add SA token option, saTokensDir, toSASecretName helper, and rewrite sc up from single re-exec to per-service secret injection.

**Artifacts:**
- [design](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/design.md)
- [spec](https://github.com/afterthought/saas-controller/blob/main/openspec/changes/docker-compose-provider/specs/sa-token-swap/spec.md)

**What to implement:**

1. Add `toSASecretName` helper in devenv.nix let block:
   ```nix
   toSASecretName = name: "OP_SA_$\{lib.toUpper (builtins.replaceStrings ["-"] ["_"] name)}";
   ```
   Matches __mac-nix/modules/home/1password.nix:35 exactly.

2. Add `saTokensDir` controller-level option (default: "$HOME/.config/secretspec/sa-tokens")

3. Add `saToken` option to secretspec submodule (nullOr str, default null)

4. Rewrite sc up secret injection:
   - Remove the __SC_SECRETS_INJECTED re-exec block entirely
   - Keep generateAllServiceSecretspecs call
   - In the service iteration loop, wrap each service's up() in a subshell that:
     a. Retrieves SA token from keyring if saToken is set (secretspec get --provider keyring)
     b. Exports OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
     c. Runs secretspec run --profile $ENVIRONMENT -- bash -c <upScript>
   - Use lib.escapeShellArg for the upScript to handle multi-line bash
   - Handle both single-service and all-services code paths

5. Update TEMPLATE.nix docs with saToken usage example

**Files:**
- Modify: `devenv.nix` (options, sc up command, let block)
- Modify: `providers/TEMPLATE.nix` (docs)

**Verification:**
- sc up starts services with per-service secret injection
- SA token retrieval works for services with saToken configured
- Services without saToken continue working with inherited token
- No __SC_SECRETS_INJECTED variable in codebase
